items.author: thymine.bsky.social
items.context:
Finally trying MHWilds on the Steam deck & it's rather laggy. What do y'all do to help?
image, no description
items.text: Heavy games like that usually run better with lower graphics settings plus a frame limit in the Deck's quick access menu. Even 30 fps feels smoother when it stays steady.

items.text: Stardew Valley and A Short Hike both have gentle soundtracks that fit that vibe well.
